labels: Elbows high, squeeze the back of your shoulders

text.setup: Hinge forward until your torso is close to parallel with the floor, flat back, arms hanging straight.
cues: Pull with your elbows flared out to the sides, not tucked in.
Bring the weight towards your upper chest rather than your belly.
Squeeze the back of your shoulders at the top, then lower slowly.
mistakes: Tucking the elbows, which makes it a normal row.
Shrugging the weight up with the traps.

variants.dumbbells: A light bell in each hand; let the elbows travel wide.
variants.barbell: A wide overhand grip helps keep the elbows out.
variants.cable: Use a rope on a low pulley in front of you.
variants.machine: Set the chest pad so your arms are straight when you reach the handles.
